newsitem.title: USA: HFS still sees Montgomery unit as good fit.
newsitem.headline: HFS still sees Montgomery unit as good fit.

text.p: HFS Inc said Tuesday it sees the potential acquisition of Montgomery Ward Co's Signature division as fitting its strategic objectives.

"(HFS) has fulfilled its strategic objective in direct marketing through its pending merger with CUC International (Inc ) " HFS said in a statement. "However, the company continues to focus on acquisitions which are strategic, and earnings per share and cash flow additive. We believe the potential acquisition of Signature may achieve those objectives upon the successful conclusion of the reorganization of Montgomery Ward."
No one at HFS was immediately available for further comment.
Privately held Montgomery Ward filed Chapter 11 on Monday. The sale of Signature was expected to raise about $1 billion, according to reports.
